metadata.source_document: 2025_Total_Rates.PDF (Michigan Dept. of Treasury, Property Services Division)
disclaimers: Millage rates are those levied and billed in 2025. Rates for 2026 will be posted in spring 2027. Rates do not include the 1% property tax administration fee.

The base principal_residence_rate and nonhomestead_rate columns do not include special assessments. The *_w_special_assessment columns include special assessments levied on a millage basis township/city/village-wide, and police/fire/ALS special assessments levied township-wide excluding a village. They do not include other special assessments.

In a few local unit/school district combinations, community college millage is levied on some properties but not others, or there are different community colleges in parts of the area — the source database uses only one community college rate (or none). This is the likely cause of the ambiguous_combo_count entries above.

Some properties transferred from one school district to another pay operating millage to one district and debt millage to another; the source database typically does not include rates for these transfer properties.
metadata.estimator_note: Blueprint Section 3 calculates the initial estimate from the BASE rate columns (principal_residence_rate / nonhomestead_rate), which exclude special assessments — consistent with the app's disclaimer that special assessments are not included.
